2317-5478-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
2317-5478-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

2226-5125-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-5125-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sparkcaster by paying its mana cost.
When Sparkcaster enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

640-4279-5075--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
640-4279-5075--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3490-6006-7075-8201.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6006-7075-8201.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

687-2138-4613-5231-8130.description:
Cast Lazotep Reaver by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Lazotep Reaver enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Lazotep Reaver and the creature token, adding two mana.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Lazotep Reaver from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-2138-4613-5231-8130.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

728-2506-3249-4289--52.easyPrerequisites:
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.

728-2506-3249-4289--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-5468.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2511-5468.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

654-880-7889.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-7889.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Amulet of Vigor.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Down in the Valley, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Down in the Valley trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

5627-6529-7857.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
5627-6529-7857.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6769-7693.easyPrerequisites:
There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
3532-5078-6769-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

997-3240-6462-7396.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2921-4681-5170-7452.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

5864-6723-7109.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four in any combination of Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats that don't have summoning sickness.
5864-6723-7109.description:
Activate any number of Birds, Frogs, Otters and/or Rats by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to a Bird, Frog, Otter or Rat.
Activate the creature by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

14-147-6798.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

141-413-1269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-413-1269.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Exhume.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1661-5051-5078-6006.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

465-618-6798.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1479-5700-5701-6517-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6517-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2457-4094-4289-6633.easyPrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2457-4094-4289-6633.description:

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Auriok Salvagers by paying {2}, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1167-1528-2787.notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {R}.
1167-1528-2787.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to gain control of an opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast Reins of Power by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting the opponent you have control of.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Reins of Power.
Resolve the copy of Reins of Power, untapping all creatures you and the opponent control, and exchanging control of those creatures.
As the opponent, activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Reins of Power.
Resolve the copy of Reins of Power, untapping all creatures you and the opponent control, and exchanging control of those creatures.
Repeat from step 3.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{R}, you may choose to have yourself and/or the opponent you have control of to gain infinite mana.

Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.

Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

643-3767-3784.description:

Activate Vhal by paying {2}, untapping it.

Resolve Ith's ability, untapping itself.
